name: Non-Hydraulic Fat Lime Putty (Slaked White Lime / Class C Lime)
traditional_use: Fine joint pointing, decorative stucco, burnished plaster (ghootai), and delicate carving repairs in sheltered or non-submerged zones.

moisture_behavior.capillary_suction: High capillary openness allowing rapid vapor transport
moisture_behavior.summary: Maximum moisture transmission capability, ideal for salt-laden or highly humid upper masonry.

mechanical_characteristics.stiffness: Extremely low modulus of elasticity (0.8-2.0 GPa)
mechanical_characteristics.sacrificial_behavior: Ultra-sacrificial; protects delicate decorative friezes from cracking
mechanical_characteristics.summary: Very soft and yielding; cannot be used in primary structural foundation retaining walls.

thermal_characteristics.thermal_shock_resilience: High compliance with host stone expansion
thermal_characteristics.summary: Cushions microscopic expansion of porous carved stones.

chemical_considerations.reactivity_with_limestone: Pure calcium carbonate matrix upon atmospheric carbonation
chemical_considerations.summary: Cannot set under water; requires atmospheric carbon dioxide to carbonate.

reversibility.extraction_method: Gentle water softening and manual scraper

heritage_compatibility.iks_alignment: Traditional aging of slaked lime putty in pits for 6-12 months per ancient Shilpa Shastra prescriptions
heritage_compatibility.asi_intach_compliance: Fully compliant with ASI and INTACH conservation standards
heritage_compatibility.authenticity_status: Historically authentic finishing and fine-jointing material

limitations: Non-hydraulic: does NOT set under water and must not be used below high-water levels without pozzolanic admixture.
Slow carbonation rate requires extended protection from freezing and direct rain.
